info.name: Branivo OCR — Talon Testing
info.description:
Test the branivo-ocr microservice endpoints at http://localhost:8888.

Endpoints:
- POST /ocr/talon?step=1|2|3  — OCR a talon image (multipart)
- POST /ocr/preview?step=1|2|3 — See the preprocessed image Tesseract receives
- GET  /health                  — Service health check

Usage:
1. Set the 'file' field to your .jpg/.png photo of the Bulgarian registration certificate
2. Add optional 'points' field for perspective crop (JSON array of 4 [x,y] pairs, normalized 0..1)
3. Add ?debug=true to get per-block breakdown and preprocessed image

Response always includes 'raw_text' — full Tesseract output, no truncation.

request.description: Verify the OCR service is running

query.description: Returns debug_info (per-block confidence) and preview_b64 (preprocessed image)

formdata.description: Photo of the OWNER page (C.2.1 Фамилия, C.2.2 Собствено, C.2.3 Адрес, ЕГН/ЛНЧ)
OPTIONAL: [[x1,y1],[x2,y2],[x3,y3],[x4,y4]] normalized 0..1 — top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left. Leave empty to skip perspective crop.

request.description:
Step 1: Scan the owner data page (MRZ zone, EGN, address).

Fields extracted: ownerName, egn, registrationNumber, vin

Response includes:
- data: parsed field values
- confidence: merged score (ocr * 0.6 + field * 0.4)
- complete: true if confidence >= 0.90
- raw_text: full Tesseract output (no truncation)
- debug_info: per-block breakdown (requires debug=true)
- preview_b64: preprocessed image base64 (requires debug=true)

formdata.description: Photo of the FRONT page (A рег. номер, E рама/VIN, D.1 марка, R цвят, No талон)

request.description:
Step 2: Scan the vehicle identity page.

Fields extracted: registrationNumber, vin, make, model, year

formdata.description: Photo of the BACK page (J категория, B 1-ва рег., P.1 обем, P.2 мощност, P.3 гориво, S.1 места, V.9 EURO)

request.description:
Step 3: Scan the technical specs page.

Fields extracted: fuel, engine, seats, firstRegistration
